reply_text:
I answered Marcus in his #north-team thread: the main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines. Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 during the morning shift. The public North cheat sheet also lists Thea as the account's main contact. Marcus can see both.

The knowledge brain (gbrain) refused the search again for the same reason as before: its access key isn't tied to any member. I answered from the channel and file I'd already read for Dana, both of which Marcus can see. Someone with admin rights on the server where gbrain runs still needs to set it up to act on behalf of the person asking. I'd avoid opening it to every page instead, since it serves several people.
